nodes.name: buck_12v_to_5v
nodes.description: TPS54331 buck converter module converting VIN_12V to VCC_5V. EN pin must be configured for proper startup/turn-on behavior (may be tied to VIN_12V or controlled via a resistor network). VSENSE pin is for feedback sensing; this module provides VCC_5V rail distribution.

nodes.name: BOOT
nodes.description: Bootstrap capacitor connection for high-side MOSFET gate drive

nodes.name: EN
nodes.description: Enable input, active high, <1.25V disables device, float to enable

nodes.name: SS
nodes.description: Soft-start programming pin, external capacitor sets output rise time

nodes.name: VSENSE
nodes.description: Inverting input of transconductance error amplifier, feedback sensing node

nodes.name: COMP
nodes.description: Error amplifier output and PWM comparator input, connect frequency compensation components

nodes.name: PH
nodes.description: Switch node, source of internal high-side power MOSFET

nodes.name: ldo_5v_to_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO module converting VCC_5V to VCC_3V3. Requires input and output bypass capacitors. This module is the VCC_3V3 distribution hub.

nodes.name: ldo_3v3_to_1v8
nodes.description: ME6211 LDO module converting VCC_3V3 to VCC_1V8. CE pin must be configured for enable control (may be tied to VCC_3V3 for always-on). Requires input and output bypass capacitors.

nodes.name: CE
nodes.description: Chip Enable. ME6211C: active high (>=1.0V ON). Tie to VIN for always-on.

nodes.name: comparator_monitor_3v3
nodes.description: LM393 comparator module monitoring VCC_3V3 rail. Channel 1 compares sensed VCC_3V3 against a threshold to generate POWER_GOOD open-drain output. Channel 2 inputs are tied to GND as per brief. VCC power is from VCC_3V3 rail. This module owns the POWER_GOOD output signal.
Dual comparator; use channel 1 for VCC_3V3 monitor, tie channel 2 inputs to GND

nodes.name: 1OUT
nodes.description: Comparator 1 output, open-drain. Requires external pull-up resistor.

nodes.name: 1IN_N
nodes.description: Comparator 1 inverting input (-). Common mode: 0V to VCC-1.5V.

nodes.name: 1IN_P
nodes.description: Comparator 1 non-inverting input (+). Common mode: 0V to VCC-1.5V.

nodes.name: 2IN_P
nodes.description: Comparator 2 non-inverting input (+). Common mode: 0V to VCC-1.5V.

nodes.name: 2IN_N
nodes.description: Comparator 2 inverting input (-). Common mode: 0V to VCC-1.5V.

nodes.name: 2OUT
nodes.description: Comparator 2 output, open-drain. Requires external pull-up resistor.

nodes.name: VCC
nodes.description: Positive supply, 2.0V to 36V. Low quiescent: 0.4mA typ.
